description: Start an order for the shopper on this storefront. Give the shopper's email address (ask them first; they get one confirmation email) or a connection key they made on their account. The answer holds the order reference (mo1_…): keep it and send it with every later call as Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or as the ref argument. It belongs to this endpoint only and expires 30 days after its last use (7 days while unconfirmed).

key.description: A connection key (mk1_…) the shopper made on their account, instead of the email

name: start_order
title: Start order
